Check the data type of a value and test it with isinstance().

Supplied answer
x = 200
y = "surya"
z = [1, 2, 3]
print(type(x), type(y), type(z))
print(isinstance(x, int)) # True
print(isinstance(y, (int, str))) # True - tuple means "any of these"
Note: type() tells the exact type; isinstance() also returns True for subclasses.
